complexity_rationale: CRUD + filtered listing + soft-delete + outbox event emission; no multi-service orchestration, no concurrent lock-order hazard, no state machine. Bounded scope qualifies as standard per TL notes.

tables.name: categories
indexes: UNIQUE (parent_category_id, name)                         -- name unique within non-root level (CATE-001)
UNIQUE (name) WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL            -- name unique at root level (CATE-001)
tables.notes: Two UNIQUE constraints cover name-uniqueness-within-level: one for root (parent IS NULL), one for non-root (same parent). Slug is globally unique. level is informational; no FK enforcement of level vs parent depth in MVP.

tables.name: products
indexes: INDEX idx_products_listing (status, visible, category_id) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND visible = TRUE  -- category filter on storefront (PERF-001)
INDEX idx_products_price   (status, visible, price)       WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND visible = TRUE  -- price-range filter (PERF-001)
INDEX idx_products_created (status, visible, created_at)  WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND visible = TRUE  -- sort created_desc (PERF-001)
tables.notes: price stored as NUMERIC(12,2); all amounts in THB per cross-cutting.pricing. Partial indexes omit DELETED/DRAFT/INACTIVE rows — reduces index size since non-public statuses are never in storefront queries. id is UUID v7 (generated in Go before INSERT so it can be embedded in the outbox payload in the same tx).

tables.name: product_images
tables.notes: URLs stored as strings (CDN-hosted). product.create and product.update replace the full image set atomically (DELETE WHERE product_id + batch INSERT) inside the same tx as the products write. ON DELETE CASCADE handles FK cleanup if a product is hard-deleted (not expected in MVP — soft-delete keeps the row).

tables.name: product_status_history

columns.name: changed_field
columns.notes: NULL = status-only or multi-field change; else e.g. 'price'

indexes: INDEX (product_id, created_at DESC)   -- audit trail ordered by time
tables.notes: Audit-light per CAT-008. MVP-policy: one row per product.create (from_status=NULL) and one row per product.update call (changed_field=NULL, old_value/new_value = JSON object of all changed fields). product.soft-delete writes from_status=<current>, to_status='DELETED'. Full per-field audit hookup deferred post-MVP.

tables.name: outbox_events

columns.name: id
columns.notes: UUID v7 — monotonic; relay scans ORDER BY id ASC

columns.name: payload_json
columns.notes: full event payload including eventId (UUID v7), occurredAt (RFC3339), productId, sku

columns.name: published_at
columns.notes: NULL = pending; relay marks non-null after Kafka ACK

indexes: INDEX (published_at) WHERE published_at IS NULL   -- relay scan; partial keeps index tiny
tables.notes: Outbox pattern per cross-cutting.persistence. In-process relay goroutine: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100 ORDER BY id; publish to ecom.catalog.events with partition key = sku (extracted from payload_json); UPDATE SET published_at=NOW(). At-least-once; consumer dedup on eventId (UUID v7). Relay tick: 5s (OUTBOX_RELAY_INTERVAL_SECONDS env). Graceful shutdown respects context cancellation.

endpoints.name: product.list
endpoints.auth_notes: Public endpoint — registered outside the JWT middleware group. No Authorization header required or expected.

filter.maxPrice: number? (>=0, must be >= minPrice if both present)
filter.search: string? (max 200 chars; ILIKE match against name)

data.items: Product[] (ACTIVE+visible only; each item: productId, sku, name, price, category{categoryId,name,slug}, thumbnailUrl (images[0] by sort_order), status)

validation_rules: page >= 1; VALIDATION_ERROR if < 1
limit: integer 1..100 inclusive; VALIDATION_ERROR if out of range
sort: must be one of 5 enum values; VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise
categoryId: if present, valid UUID format; VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise
minPrice/maxPrice: non-negative; maxPrice >= minPrice if both supplied
search: trimmed; ignored if empty after trim; max 200 chars

error_contract.triggers: page<1, limit out of range, bad sort enum, malformed UUID, maxPrice<minPrice, search>200 chars
inStock=true and inventory.stock.bulk-read returns 503 or times out (>2s); surface to caller — do NOT silently return empty or unfiltered list

edge_behavior: inStock=true: Phase-1 fetches current page of ACTIVE+visible rows (other filters applied). Phase-2 calls inventory.stock.bulk-read ({skus: [...]}) with 2s timeout via common/httpclient. Filter out products where availableQty=0 or sku absent from response. Returned count may be < limit if many items are OOS — MVP-acceptable; document in consumer notes.
inStock=true + inventory unavailable: return UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT (504). Do not silently return an unfiltered list.
categoryId filter: direct-only (no recursive subcategory expansion in MVP).
Pagination stable: ORDER BY (sort_col, product_id ASC) — ties break deterministically.
search filter: ILIKE '%term%' on name — acceptable at 1k-SKU scale per PERF-001.
No review data in listing — reviewSummary is only on product.detail.
implementation_hints: Single parameterized WHERE clause (no dynamic SQL string concat): WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND visible=TRUE AND ($1::uuid IS NULL OR category_id=$1::uuid) AND ($2::numeric IS NULL OR price>=$2::numeric) AND ($3::numeric IS NULL OR price<=$3::numeric) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%'||$4||'%').
COUNT: same WHERE clause, omit ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET — run as separate query or window function.

Indexes: idx_products_listing (category_id filter), idx_products_price (price range), idx_products_created (created_desc sort) — all partial WHERE ACTIVE+visible. Validate with EXPLAIN ANALYZE on 1k seed.
inStock call: POST http://inventory-svc/api/v1/inventory/stock/bulk-read {skus:[...]} via common/httpclient; map response to map[sku]availableQty; filter candidates where qty > 0.
Image join: LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.product_id=p.id AND pi.sort_order=(SELECT MIN(sort_order) FROM product_images WHERE product_id=p.id) — or subquery for first image per product.
Handler file: internal/handler/product_list.go; Repo: internal/repository/product.go ListProducts(ctx, filter, page, limit, sort).

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: inStock=true via inventory.stock.bulk-read; UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT if inventory down

endpoints.name: product.detail
endpoints.auth_notes: Public for ACTIVE products. Optional Authorization header — if present and valid ADMIN role, DELETED/DRAFT products are returned. If absent or CUSTOMER role, DELETED/DRAFT products return NOT_FOUND.
validation_rules: productId: required, valid UUID; VALIDATION_ERROR if malformed
Product must exist; NOT_FOUND if row absent
DELETED/DRAFT products: NOT_FOUND for guest/CUSTOMER callers; full record for ADMIN callers

error_contract.triggers: product absent, DELETED for non-admin, DRAFT for non-admin
inventory.stock.read times out >2s; stockStatus returned as OUT_OF_STOCK (safe fallback); timeout logged as WARN but NOT surfaced to caller — detail endpoint stays functional

edge_behavior: stockStatus thresholds: availableQty > 10 → IN_STOCK; 1–10 → LOW; 0 → OUT_OF_STOCK. If inventory unavailable: log warning, return OUT_OF_STOCK (safe fallback — storefront stays functional).
reviewSummary: always {averageRating: null, reviewCount: 0} — Reviews deferred per EPIC_CATALOG out-of-scope.
INACTIVE products: returned to all callers with status=INACTIVE so cart/checkout can flag PRODUCT_INACTIVE without a separate call.
Used as upstream dependency by cart.add-item and checkout.commit step 4 — those services call this endpoint; they receive status so they can enforce PRODUCT_INACTIVE/PRODUCT_DELETED checks.
implementation_hints: Query 1: SELECT p.*, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.slug AS cat_slug FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.id=$1.
Query 2: SELECT url FROM product_images WHERE product_id=$1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC.
Query 3 (best-effort): POST inventory-svc /api/v1/inventory/stock/read {sku} with 2s timeout via common/httpclient.

Role check: parse Authorization header if present via common/token.ParseUnverifiedClaims (or full verify if token present); if claims.role=ADMIN, skip status filter. If absent or CUSTOMER, hide status IN ('DELETED','DRAFT') behind NOT_FOUND.
Handler file: internal/handler/product_detail.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: DELETED product returns NOT_FOUND to non-admin; Order uses snapshot — no Catalog call required from Order service
DRAFT/INACTIVE/DELETED status rules enforced per caller role

endpoints.name: product.create
endpoints.auth_notes: ADMIN role only. Reject CUSTOMER token with AUTH_FORBIDDEN (403). Uses common/middleware JWT group.

request_schema.name: string (required; 1..255 chars)
request_schema.images: string[]? (optional; max 20 URLs; each URL max 2048 chars)
request_schema.price: number (required; >0; THB; up to 2 decimal places)
request_schema.categoryId: string (required; UUID; must reference existing active category)

validation_rules: sku: required, non-empty, max 100 chars
name: required, non-empty, max 255 chars
price: required, > 0, max 2 decimal places
categoryId: required, valid UUID, must exist in categories AND be active
status: if provided, must be DRAFT or ACTIVE (INACTIVE and DELETED are forbidden on create)
images: if provided, max 20 entries; each non-empty string max 2048 chars
Actor must have role=ADMIN (JWT middleware enforces before handler)

error_contract.triggers: missing required fields, price<=0, invalid status enum, malformed UUID, images>20, sku>100 chars
LOWER(sku) already exists in products table (DB unique-constraint violation)
categoryId does not exist or category is inactive

edge_behavior: SKU uniqueness: UNIQUE constraint on LOWER(sku). Handler catches pgconn.PgError Code=23505 on constraint categories_sku_lower_key and returns DUPLICATE_SKU.

Outbox write: product INSERT + outbox_events INSERT in SAME DB transaction. Payload: {eventId: uuid_v7(), occurredAt: RFC3339, productId: <new-id>, sku: <sku>}. If tx rolls back (e.g. DUPLICATE_SKU from DB), no outbox row is written.
Relay goroutine picks up outbox row and publishes to ecom.catalog.events partition key=sku. Inventory seeds stock_levels(sku, 0, 0, 0) on receipt.
status=ACTIVE on create: product immediately visible in listing. status=DRAFT: hidden from storefront.
product_status_history: INSERT (from_status=NULL, to_status=<status>, actor_user_id=claims.sub) inside same tx — NULL from_status marks initial creation.
implementation_hints: Generate product_id = uuid_v7() in Go before INSERT (ID needed in outbox payload in same tx).

Transaction (pgx): BEGIN; INSERT products; INSERT product_images (batch if non-empty); INSERT product_status_history (from_status=NULL); INSERT outbox_events (id=uuid_v7(), event_type='product.created', payload_json, published_at=NULL); COMMIT.
Relay: go catalog.StartOutboxRelay(ctx, db, kafkaProducer) in main.go. Relay query: SELECT id, payload_json FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
Handler file: internal/handler/product_create.go. Service: internal/service/product.go ProductCreate(ctx, req, actorUserID).

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: ADMIN creates product with unique SKU, price>0, valid categoryId; 409 DUPLICATE_SKU on repeat
status enum DRAFT|ACTIVE enforced on create; INACTIVE/DELETED forbidden

endpoints.name: product.update

request_schema.name: string? (optional; 1..255 chars)
request_schema.images: string[]? (optional; replaces full image set; max 20)
request_schema.status: string? (optional; enum: DRAFT|ACTIVE|INACTIVE — DELETED not settable via update)
request_schema.categoryId: string? (optional; UUID; must reference existing active category)

validation_rules: productId: required, valid UUID, must exist; NOT_FOUND if absent
At least one optional field must be present; VALIDATION_ERROR if empty patch
price: if provided, must be > 0
status: if provided, only DRAFT|ACTIVE|INACTIVE (cannot set DELETED via update — use soft-delete endpoint)
categoryId: if provided, must exist and be active
SKU is NOT editable in MVP (locked per catalog.product.update contract)
Cannot update a DELETED product — return NOT_FOUND (treat DELETED as non-existent)

error_contract.triggers: empty patch, price<=0, invalid status enum (DELETED), categoryId inactive/absent, malformed UUID

edge_behavior: product_status_history: one row per update call; changed_field=NULL; old_value/new_value = JSONB of all changed fields. MVP-policy: full per-field audit deferred.
images: if images field present in request, DELETE all existing product_images for product, INSERT new set — both in same tx as products UPDATE.
price change: no downstream event emitted in MVP (Order uses snapshot). Audit row written locally.
status change ACTIVE→INACTIVE: product immediately hidden from storefront listing; cart.read re-checks product.detail and flags items as non-checkoutable.
Outbox: product.updated event written (event_type='product.updated'; payload: {eventId, occurredAt, productId, sku, changedFields}). No consumer in MVP — written for future extensibility.
implementation_hints: Read-then-write: SELECT products FOR UPDATE WHERE id=$1 — get current state for audit old_value and DELETED check.

Transaction: SELECT FOR UPDATE; validate; UPDATE products SET ..., updated_at=NOW(); replace images if supplied (DELETE+INSERT); INSERT product_status_history; INSERT outbox_events (product.updated); COMMIT.
Handler file: internal/handler/product_update.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: price/status edits recorded in product_status_history; MVP-policy flag on full per-field audit
status DELETED not settable via update; VALIDATION_ERROR

endpoints.name: product.soft-delete
validation_rules: productId: required, valid UUID; NOT_FOUND if row absent in DB
Idempotent: if product already DELETED, return 200 status=DELETED immediately — no writes

error_contract.triggers: productId row does not exist in DB

edge_behavior: Soft-delete idempotency: SELECT status FROM products WHERE id=$1. If status='DELETED', return 200 immediately — no history row, no outbox write.

If not yet DELETED: UPDATE products SET status='DELETED', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 AND status!='DELETED'. INSERT product_status_history (from_status=<current>, to_status='DELETED', actor_user_id=claims.sub). One tx.
No outbox event emitted for soft-delete — not required by any consumer contract in MVP (Inventory does not need to react; Order uses snapshot).
Storefront listing: product excluded because status!='ACTIVE'. product.detail returns NOT_FOUND to non-admin.
Historical orders: Order service stores productNameSnapshot, productImageUrlSnapshot, priceSnapshot on order_items at checkout-time; resolving those fields requires no Catalog call (CAT-009 / BA AC).
implementation_hints: Use UPDATE products SET status='DELETED', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 RETURNING status — if rowsAffected=0 AND product exists with status='DELETED', treat as idempotent success.
Handler file: internal/handler/product_soft_delete.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: product hidden from listing/detail post-delete; historical order snapshots self-contained; no Catalog call from Order service

endpoints.name: category.create

request_schema.name: string (required; 1..255 chars)
request_schema.slug: string (required; globally unique; 1..255 chars; lowercase-alphanumeric-hyphen recommended)

validation_rules: name: required, non-empty, max 255 chars
slug: required, non-empty, max 255 chars; must be globally unique across all categories
parentCategoryId: if provided, must exist in categories table (active OR inactive — no active requirement for parent)
level: must be >= 1 (informational; no strict depth-vs-parent enforcement in MVP)
name uniqueness within level enforced by DB unique constraints

error_contract.triggers: missing required fields, empty name/slug, level<1, malformed UUID for parentCategoryId
name already exists at same level (same parent or both root)

edge_behavior: DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME: caught by DB constraint violation on (parent_category_id, name) or UNIQUE (name) WHERE parent IS NULL. Handler maps constraint name → error code.
CONFLICT (slug): caught by DB constraint on (slug). Distinct from DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME.
Root-level category (parentCategoryId absent): null parent is fine; uniqueness enforced by partial index.
implementation_hints: Generate categoryId = uuid_v7() in Go.
INSERT INTO categories (id, name, slug, parent_category_id, level, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (...).
Constraint name mapping: categories_parent_category_id_name_key → DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME; categories_name_parent_null_key → DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME; categories_slug_key → CONFLICT.
Handler file: internal/handler/category_create.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: name unique within level enforced; 409 DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME on collision

endpoints.name: category.update
validation_rules: categoryId: required, valid UUID, must exist
At least one of name or slug must be provided; VALIDATION_ERROR on empty patch
name: if provided, must be unique within the same level/parent
slug: if provided, must be globally unique (CATE-002)

error_contract.triggers: new name conflicts with sibling at same level

edge_behavior: Last-writer-wins on name and slug.
Inactive categories can be updated (name/slug edits allowed even when active=false).
implementation_hints: UPDATE categories SET name=COALESCE($1, name), slug=COALESCE($2, slug), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$3 RETURNING *.
Catch unique-constraint violations — same mapping as category.create.
Handler file: internal/handler/category_update.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: slug globally unique enforced; 409 CONFLICT on collision

endpoints.name: category.deactivate
validation_rules: categoryId: required, valid UUID, must exist; NOT_FOUND if absent
edge_behavior: Idempotent: if already active=false, return 200 with active=false immediately (no-op).
Products in this category are NOT soft-deleted or auto-hidden — they retain their own status. Category filter in product.list simply won't return this category as a filter option.
category.list with activeOnly=true stops returning this category.
CATE-003: products in deactivated category continue to appear in storefront listing until their own status changes.
implementation_hints: UPDATE categories SET active=FALSE, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 — idempotent by nature of SET active=FALSE.
Handler file: internal/handler/category_deactivate.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: inactive category excluded from activeOnly=true list; associated products unaffected

endpoints.name: category.list
endpoints.auth_notes: Public endpoint. activeOnly defaults to true for storefront. Callers may pass activeOnly=false to see inactive categories — no auth gate in MVP (see ambiguities).

data.categories: Category[] — flat list ordered by level ASC, name ASC. Each item: {categoryId, name, slug, parentCategoryId, level, active}

edge_behavior: activeOnly=true: WHERE active=TRUE. activeOnly=false: no active filter.
MVP: returns flat list; tree reconstruction (parentCategoryId nesting) is client-side responsibility.
No auth enforcement for activeOnly=false — inactive categories are not sensitive data; known limitation per ambiguities section.
implementation_hints: SELECT id, name, slug, parent_category_id, level, active FROM categories WHERE ($1::boolean IS NULL OR active=$1) ORDER BY level ASC, name ASC.
Handler file: internal/handler/category_list.go.

ba_acceptance_mapping.coverage: activeOnly=true hides inactive categories from storefront filter

key_files: cmd/main.go                              — service entry; starts HTTP server, DB pool, Kafka producer, outbox relay goroutine
internal/repository/product.go           — DB queries for products + product_images + product_status_history (pgx)
internal/repository/outbox.go            — outbox INSERT + relay scan/mark helpers
internal/outbox/relay.go                 — StartOutboxRelay(ctx, db, producer): goroutine; polls outbox, sends to Kafka, marks published_at
internal/client/inventory.go             — HTTP client for inventory.stock.read and inventory.stock.bulk-read (common/httpclient; 2s timeout)

produced.trigger: product.create — written to outbox_events in SAME tx as products INSERT
produced.consumer: inventory — seeds stock_levels(sku, 0, 0, 0) on first receipt; dedup on eventId

produced.trigger: product.update — written to outbox inside update tx
produced.consumer: none in MVP — written for future extensibility

outbox_relay.query: SELECT id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload_json FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
outbox_relay.mark_published: UPDATE outbox_events SET published_at = NOW() WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])
outbox_relay.kafka_send: common/kafka producer; partition key = payload_json->>'sku'; topic = ecom.catalog.events
outbox_relay.shutdown: relay goroutine respects context cancellation; drains in-flight batch before exit

unit_tests: service/product_test.go: ProductCreate validation (invalid price, duplicate SKU mapping, missing category, images>20); ProductUpdate empty-patch rejection, DELETED rejection; ProductSoftDelete idempotency
outbox/relay_test.go: processes batch, marks published_at after ACK, skips already-published rows, does NOT mark on Kafka error
integration_tests: product.list: 1000-seed; page=1 limit=20 sort=price_asc → 20 items; categoryId filter; price range filter; inStock=true with stubbed inventory; VALIDATION_ERROR limit=101
product.create: ADMIN→201+productId; CUSTOMER→403; duplicate SKU→409 DUPLICATE_SKU; inactive category→404; outbox row present+published_at NULL before relay
product.soft-delete: first call→DELETED+history row; second call idempotent→DELETED no extra history row
category.create: dup name same level→409 DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME; dup slug→409 CONFLICT
outbox integration: product.create→outbox row; relay tick→published_at non-null; Kafka message partition key=sku
test_strategy.performance_target: PERF-001: p95 < 300ms on product.list with 1000-SKU seed in local Docker Compose. Validate with EXPLAIN ANALYZE on idx_products_listing and idx_products_price.
test_strategy.ba_coverage: All BA ACs in ba_acceptance_mapping must have at least one integration test path

ambiguities.description: Phase-1 fetches exactly `limit` rows from DB, then Phase-2 filters by stock. If many items are OOS, returned page may have fewer than `limit` items. Total count is before stock filter (approximate).
ambiguities.resolution: Accepted per MVP scope. Document in API consumer notes. Over-fetch strategy deferred post-MVP.

ambiguities.description: activeOnly=false is intended for admin but the endpoint has no JWT gate. Any caller can see inactive categories. Not sensitive data but may be unintended.
ambiguities.resolution: MVP: no auth gate. Known limitation documented. Post-MVP: optional-auth middleware + ADMIN claim check for activeOnly=false.
ambiguities.owner: Tech-Designer (catalog) — surfaced; BA/TL alignment may be needed

ambiguities.description: catalog.product.update contract says 'Publishes product.updated event' but no consumer is defined in contracts.json for MVP.
ambiguities.resolution: Write the outbox row anyway. No consumer in MVP. No contract bump needed for producer side.
